en.answer: Even if <<7247>> is no longer on the field when its effect resolves, the effect is applied normally. The targeted monster is Special Summoned, and damage calculation is conducted. (No replay occurs.)
en.question: If <<5914>> is chained to the effect of <<7247>>, so that <<7247>> is no longer on the field when its effect resolves, does the effect apply?
en.title: If <<5914>> is chained to the effect of <<7247>>, so that <<7247>> is no longer on the field when its effect resolves, does the effect apply?

ja.answer:
「<<7247>>」の効果処理時に、「<<7247>>」自身がフィールドを離れている場合でも、効果処理は通常通り適用されます。

選択したモンスターは特殊召喚され、戦闘ダメージ計算まで行われる事になります。
（この場合、戦闘の巻き戻しは発生しません。）
